snippet.title: 🎮 Rastan (Master System) Complete Gameplay
snippet.description:
Rastan is a side-scrolling action game released for the Sega Master System in 1989. A barbarian bounty hunter called Rastan has embarked on a quest to slay a dragon and rescue a princess. While on his way to the dragon's lair, Rastan must fight hordes of enemy monsters based on mythical creatures such as chimeras and harpies.

Developer: Taito 
Publisher: Sega 
Release date: 1989 
Platform: Sega Master System
